propositions: Batch-path verdicts systematically return confidence=0.0 despite successful model calls, causing aggregate to reject all pairs below the 0.7 threshold and never surface findings.
The flat output_token_limit=1024 truncates multi-candidate batches (K up to 20 → 10-pair batches), causing whole batches to abstain when responses are incomplete.
The batch entry JSON schema had no required fields for candidate_id, relation, and confidence, allowing the model to omit them or produce malformed multi-entry tool arguments.
Unit tests pass with canned runners but miss live calibration; no test validates that near-duplicate pairs actually surface with confidence >= 0.7.
The fix requires scaling output budget dynamically per batch cardinality (256 + 192*n tokens) and marking candidate_id, relation, confidence, and abstain as required in the contract schema.
After the fix lands, the surfaced-findings rate must be re-measured to confirm the mechanism works end-to-end and determine whether the feature warrants continued operation or should be scrapped.
